basic_info.description: Elegant top-floor condo in Presidio Heights designed for modern city living. With 4 bedrooms and 2 baths (1 full + 2 half combined to create a second full), this home offers the perfect balance of space, flexibility, and style. Two bedrooms easily fit king-size beds, while the additional rooms are ideal for guest accommodations or dual home officesperfect for professionals working from home.    The light-filled interior blends classic San Francisco architecture with modern upgrades: high ceilings, stained-glass windows, detailed moldings, and a decorative fireplace with views of the Golden Gate Bridge and the Presidio. Updates include energy-efficient windows, a fully renovated kitchen with La Cornue gas range, and bathrooms featuring artisan Portuguese tilework.    Unwind or entertain on the shared rooftop deck with sweeping city and bay views. Steps away are the Presidio, Michelin-rated restaurants, boutique shopping, and top schoolseverything you need within walking distance.    For professionals who want both character and convenience, this Presidio Heights gem delivers timeless style with a flexible layout designed for today's lifestyles.
